description:
Breathtaking actions! Only martial artists can work at the enterprise, called Kung Fu Company. A new female employee announces to run in the election for the chairman, to save her falling clan! Seoyoung’s action begins, as she challenges to become the chairman, with the help of the outsiders of the martial art jungle!   
(From KENAZ's website)
